- Constructor now resolves `IndexerTaskCountStatsProvider` via a new `getInstanceIfBound` helper using `injector.getExistingBinding(Key.get(...))`, returning `null` when no binding exists (e.g., on Peons/Historicals).
- `doMonitor` emits indexer task metrics only when `indexerStatsProvider != null`.
